decision: Pin GitHub Actions runner to ubuntu-24.04 and add build step to CI workflow.
reason: Workflow 'CI' failing on main; jobs weren't starting because account was locked for billing issue. Local checks (pnpm install, type-check, test, build) passed smoothly. Updated the workflow to use ubuntu-24.04 to fix the ubuntu-latest deprecation/migration warning, and explicitly added 'pnpm run build' to catch build-time regressions in CI.
